title: Placeholder: dashboard overview, 70 words, for VO tests and estimates only

vo.text: Spatial Adjust lives inside IntelliDash, and the whole feature is one screen with four regions.
Every station is a pin coloured by its latest measured VWC, from TurfRad scan data.
In the table, station 3AP1 measured 27.6% against a 54% target, the largest deficit on the hole.
Calculation ET matches the ET in the weather strip, and Push Changes counts the stations with an unpushed edit before anything reaches Lynx.
